Rooftop solar adoption in India

Rooftop solar capacity in India reached 18.4 gigawatts by the end of June 2026, according to the ministry's quarterly bulletin.

Residential installations accounted for 41 percent of new rooftop capacity added in the first half of 2026.

The national subsidy scheme covers up to 60 percent of system cost for installations up to 2 kilowatts.

Installers report that average payback periods have fallen to about five years in states with net metering.
